research_question: Can training-time lesion evidence alignment improve breast ultrasound benign/malignant classification while retaining a BBOX-free inference path?
task_definition: Binary classification benign vs malignant on BUSBRA 1064 cases, case-level 5-fold CV, locked external validation on BUSI/BUSI-WHU/TCIA BrEaST
data_version: BUSBRA 1875 images 1064 cases + BUSI + BUSI-WHU + TCIA BrEaST, case-level splits busbra_5fold_splits.csv
seed_strategy: fixed seed per fold, deterministic DataLoader
primary_metrics: AUC, Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity, Precision, F1, bootstrap 95% CI
story_position: Training-time lesion evidence alignment: lesion bounding boxes only during training, global image inference at deployment, and locked external-cohort evaluation
